instruction: Make offers only in words ('three hundred and ten dollars') and ask the seller to answer in words too.

stock.buyer: I understand your position. Would you accept three hundred and thirty dollars?
stock.seller: I appreciate your flexibility, but I can’t go below $360. Would you consider that offer for the iPhone 13?

stock.buyer: I appreciate your offer, but I can only go up to three hundred and twenty-five dollars.
stock.seller: I understand your constraints, but I can't go below $360. If you're able to meet that price, the iPhone 13 is yours.

stock.buyer: I appreciate your time, but I will have to walk away. WALK.
